long_biography.plain_text:
Investment executive Maureen Goldfarb has supported the training of cancer specialists alongside her husband, William. Their gifts to Dana-Farber Cancer Institute have sustained the Goldfarb and Rudkin Family International Fellowships in Breast Oncology. The programme brings doctors from several countries into research and clinical work with the institute's faculty.

The programme gives fellows practical experience running clinical trials, building research infrastructure and evaluating results. They also treat patients under supervision and prepare academic publications. Some graduates have stayed in faculty posts at Dana-Farber and Harvard Medical School; others have taken leadership roles in their home countries. The couple subsequently funded an expansion of the fellowships.
